title: matam karo ke aaj qayamat ka roz hai
body:
matam karo ke aaj qayamat ka roz hai
daswe imam ki ye shahadat ka roz hai
dunya se uthgaye hai imame ali naqi
laqte dile jawwad ki ruqsat ka roz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
be wajah qaid kar ke diya zehr aapko
ehle jahaa'n ke waaste ibrat ka roz hai
dil bande mustafa ne qaza ki jahaan se
aye momino imam ki rehlat ka roz hai
